import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";

export function Todos({ initial }: { initial: string[] }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState(initial);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState({ done: false });
  const remaining = useMemo(() => items.length, [items]);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    input.current?.focus();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${remaining} left`;
  }, [remaining]);

  const add = useCallback(() => {
    setItems([...items, text]);
    setText("");
  }, [items, text]);

  return (
    <form onSubmit={add}>
      <input ref={input} className="field" value={text} onChange={(event) => setText(event.target.value)} />
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setFilter({ done: !filter.done })}>
        {filter.done ? "Done" : "Open"}: {remaining}
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}
